name: linkify
description: Rewrites assistant replies so file paths, URLs and issue keys render as markdown links

modelResolve.title: Hidden model call
modelResolve.description: Ask the model, in a hidden cached request, which URL a PR, repo or unknown issue key refers to. /linkify model on|off overrides it.

trackers.title: Tracker links
trackers.description: One PREFIX=URL row per tracker, {key} standing for the whole key, e.g. ABC=https://linear.app/<workspace>/issue/{key}

modes.title: Rule modes
modes.description: One rule=fix|flag|off row per override, e.g. dash=fix. Rule ids are in the README.

hosts.title: Extra link hosts
hosts.description: Hosts a model-supplied URL may point at, beyond github.com, gitlab.com, linear.app and atlassian.net
